mechanism_narrative: A rising GDPC1 indicates strong economic demand, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth is positive but SPX returns are negative more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in UNRATE below 5% signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If UNRATE drops below 5% but SPX returns are not positive in majority cases.

mechanism_narrative: Increases in both INDPRO and RSAFS indicate strong supply and demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If both proxies increase but SPX returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, higher FEDFUNDS negatively impacts S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases but SPX returns are positive in majority cases during tightening.

mechanism_narrative: Low UNRATE indicates a strong economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE is low but SPX returns are negative more than 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST exceeding 1000 indicates strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns in 5 days.
failure_condition: If HOUST exceeds 1000 but SPX returns are not positive in majority cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising PAYEMS and GDPC1 indicate economic strength, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: If both proxies increase but SPX returns are negative more than 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: High CPIAUCSL in late-cycle expansion leads to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL is high but SPX returns are positive in majority cases during late-cycle.
